mapper.select: SELECT c.class_id AS 'classId', f.file_url AS 'thumbnail', c.class_title AS 'classTitle', ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(cr.rating), 0), 1) AS 'rating', COALESCE(uph.total_students, 0) AS 'allCntStudent', COALESCE(uph.total_revenue, 0) AS 'allRevenue', CASE WHEN cs.class_permit = 'N' THEN '승인 안됨' WHEN c.class_permit = 'N' THEN '승인 안됨' WHEN c.class_permit = 'Y' THEN '승인 완료' END AS 'classPermit' FROM class c LEFT JOIN file f ON f.file_no = c.file_no LEFT JOIN class_review cr ON c.class_id = cr.class_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT class_id, SUM(price) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT payment_id) AS total_students FROM user_payment_history WHERE refund_status = 'N' GROUP BY class_id ) uph ON uph.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN class_section cs ON cs.class_id = c.class_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.class_id, uph.total_revenue, uph.total_students, cs.class_permit ORDER BY c.class_id DESC;
